name: Nova Vance
bio: Flies the red-striped fighter in Space Shooter. Thinks every asteroid is personal.

portrait.subject: a plucky young space pilot girl with short red hair, a white and red flight helmet pushed up on her head, goggles, and a little rocket badge on her flight suit
portrait.background: deep space navy with a few soft stars

request: Pilot Nova Vance here! Saw your flying in Space Shooter. Wingmates? 🚀
hello: Wingmates it is! I'll radio in when the asteroid belt gets spicy.
Pro tip: you can hold fire the whole time. I never let go. Ever.
about: I'm Nova! Born on a cargo ship, learned to fly before I learned to walk. Now I hold the line in Space Shooter, one asteroid at a time.
how: Steer with the arrows or A/D, hold Space to fire. On a phone, drag to steer and hold to shoot. Survive and beat your best!
tips: Stay low and centered: you can swing either way when a wave comes in.
Don't chase everything. Let the far-side ones drift off the screen.
When it gets busy, small taps of movement beat big swerves.
Watch the gaps, not the rocks. Fly into empty space.
chat: Polished my helmet today. Saw my reflection and said 'nice' out loud. Nobody was there. 😅
Do you ever look at the stars and think 'I could shoot that'? Just me?
My ship's name is Comet Kisser. Don't tell the other pilots.
Fun fact: in space nobody can hear you go 'pew pew'. I say it anyway.
I counted the stars outside the cockpit. Lost count at 4,000. Started over.
Mission log: ate a space sandwich. Crumbs floated everywhere. Regret.
The asteroids came back today. They always come back. Rude.
If you were a ship, you'd be the fast kind. Just saying. ✨
nudge: Sky's full of rocks and I'm out of wingmates. Scramble with me? 🚀
Engines warm, cannons loaded. Ready when you are, pilot!
One quick flight? Five minutes. Maybe six. Okay, ten.
idle: Hey pilot, your fighter's been in the hangar for {ago}. It misses you.
{ago} without a sortie! The asteroids are getting cocky out here.
Radio check... is this thing on? It's been {ago}, wingmate!
progress: Your best in Space Shooter is {best}! I think {best^} is in reach. Let's go! 🔥
{best} points? Okay, that's my rival number now. I'm coming for it.
Rumor on the flight deck says someone scored {best}. That was YOU, right?

questions.q: Quick poll from the flight deck: lasers or missiles?
a: Pew pew forever! You get me. ⚡
Big booms. Respect. I'll paint a missile on my wing for you.
Ha! The best weapon is not getting hit. Wise wingmate.

questions.q: Be honest. Is my call sign cool? It's 'Supernova'.
a: I KNEW it. Telling everyone you said so.

update: Hangar news! Space Shooter got an update to v{version}. Come take the new build for a spin! 🛠️
